items.q: What is answer engine optimization in simple words?
items.a: AEO is writing and structuring your pages so that search engines and AI assistants can pick them as the direct answer to a question.

items.q: Which answer engines should I optimise for?
items.a: Google AI Overviews and featured snippets, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Bing Copilot and voice assistants. The same clear, well-structured content helps across all of them.

items.q: How should I write the first lines of a page for AEO?
items.a: Put a short, direct answer in the first one or two sentences under each question heading, then add the detail below it.

items.q: How do I add FAQ schema to my page?
items.a: Add the questions and answers as JSON-LD in your page code. Our free Schema Markup Generator creates the code for you.

items.q: How do I know if AI answers are citing my site?
items.a: Search your target questions in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity, and check Search Console for impressions on question-style queries.
